title: Eating My Way Through Tokyo on ¥5000 a Day
description: I gave myself ¥5000 a day and a rule: no restaurant twice. What followed was a week-long battle between the 7-Eleven egg sandwich, a standing soba counter in Shinjuku station, and a depachika basement that nearly ended the budget on day one. Where to queue, what to skip, and why konbini breakfast is not a compromise.

comments.comment: The egg sando discourse is settled then. Lawson's is better though, and I will die on this hill.
Did ¥5000 actually survive contact with a depachika? Asking for budgeting purposes (mine never does).
